Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent hallucinated the content of the Scikit-Learn July 2017 changelog. It claimed that "BaseBagging" received a bug fix, but the actual changelog for that release (Scikit-Learn 0.19.0) lists "BaseLabelPropagation" as the predictor base command that received a bug fix. The agent admitted it could not access the internet and relied on "known" information, which was factually incorrect in this specific instance.
